description: Lint hreflang annotations for international SEO. Accepts pasted text (not a URL; this tool never fetches anything): page HTML with <link rel="alternate" hreflang> tags, an XML sitemap with xhtml:link alternates, or a JSON set {"pages":[{"url","canonical","alternates":[{"hreflang","href"}]}]}. Checks language/script/region codes, x-default, self-reference, canonical conflicts, duplicates and reciprocal return links. Returns valid true/false, counts, the codes found, and up to 25 issues with paths, messages and suggested fixes. Read-only. Same engine as the HrefGate JSON API (POST /api/lint).

include_raw.description: Also return the full /api/lint JSON (all issues) in structuredContent.raw.

input.description: Page HTML, sitemap XML, or JSON {"pages":[{"url":"https://example.com/en/","alternates":[{"hreflang":"en","href":"https://example.com/en/"}]}]}.

page_url.description: Absolute URL of the pasted HTML page (HTML input only). Enables self-reference and canonical checks.

name: lint_hreflang

raw.description: Full /api/lint response (only when include_raw is true)

title: Lint hreflang annotations
